_comment: Editable Kuudra Etherwarp/Custom Waypoints config. Etherwarp supplies defaults are intentionally empty while the feature is being rebuilt; DPS/SKIP custom defaults are kept here.
_howToUse: Use /iq waypoints to create categories, subcategories and waypoints.
This file is valid JSON. Do not use // or /* */ comments.
Supported phases: SUPPLIES, BUILD, EATEN, STUN, DPS, SKIP, BOSS, COMPLETED

categoryFields.name: Category name. Used for organizing groups of waypoints.
categoryFields.enabled: Whether this category is active. true or false.
categoryFields.waypoints: List of waypoint objects in this category.

waypointFields.name: Waypoint name.
waypointFields.text: Optional label rendered above/below the waypoint.
waypointFields.showInPhases: Array of phases where this waypoint should appear.
waypointFields.hideInPhases: Array of phases where this waypoint should be hidden.
waypointFields.maxRenderDistance: Maximum distance to render waypoint (-1 = unlimited).
